claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings (CMV/ASSIST/AutoFlow, PEEP 5 cmH2O, set tidal volume 450 mL, set respiratory rate 16/min) and monitor airway pressures, tidal volumes, and minute ventilation.
Continue invasive hemodynamic monitoring via arterial line and pulmonary artery catheter, including cardiac output and central venous pressure, with periodic zeroing/calibration.
Continue temporary pacemaker with atrial and ventricular wires at rate 60 bpm, checking sensing/stimulation thresholds and parameters.
Continue insulin infusion with hourly or more frequent glucose monitoring (finger stick and serum glucose) and adjust to target range.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit and coagulation studies (PT/INR, PTT, fibrinogen) given anemia and coagulopathy, and transfuse blood products as clinically indicated.
Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium, chloride, ionized calcium, magnesium), renal function (creatinine, BUN), and acid-base status with arterial blood gases.
Continue vasoactive and antihypertensive infusions (phenylephrine, nitroglycerin, nicardipine) with continuous arterial blood pressure monitoring and titration to target.
Perform daily assessment of sedation (Richmond-RAS), delirium (CAM-ICU), neurologic status (GCS), pain level, and orientation.
Implement pressure ulcer prevention and skin care per Braden scale, including repositioning, moisture management, and friction/shear reduction.
Maintain ongoing prophylaxis and supportive care medications as ordered (e.g., stress ulcer prophylaxis, DVT prophylaxis if applicable, bowel regimen, and other active medications).
